# OmniYield Protocol

> Institutional-grade cross-chain AI yield aggregator and dual-vault liquidity protocol natively built on NEAR Protocol ($250k NEAR Hackathon).

## Core Capabilities
- **Dual-Vault Architecture**:
  - NUSD Core Vault: 12.40% APY (70% RHEA Lending + 30% Ondo USDY US Treasuries).
  - OmniUSDC All-Weather Vault: 16.80% APY (Bridgewater 4-Pillar Risk Parity).
- **Tri-Pillar AI Copilot**:
  - Chief Investment Advisor (Macro hedging & Pyth oracle signals).
  - Intent Quant Trader (Zero-bridge 1-click execution across 16 chains).
  - Chief Customer Concierge (24/7 sovereign support).
- **Security & Multi-Sig**:
  - SputnikDAO 2/2 Multi-Sig (`dao.omniyield-vault.testnet`).
  - Policy Authorization Sandbox (Strict intent boundary adhering to NEAR CLO's "The Right to Run" paradigm).
